alarm.title: Radiation alarm!
alarm.text: The Sun threw a cloud of particles. Get to the shelter, fast!

patrol.title: 🧽 Clean the solar panels
patrol.how1: Tap a panel and rub with the sponge to wipe off dust.
patrol.how2: Turn the knob under the panel so it faces the Sun.
patrol.how3: Reach 80% power before time runs out.
patrol.teaches: Moon dust sticks to everything. A dusty panel gives little power, and a panel facing the Sun gives the most.
patrol.hint: Rub the dust with the sponge and turn the knob to the Sun ☀️
patrol.keys: Keys: 1–{n} pick, Q/E tilt, Space to wipe

bricks.title: Build a shield wall
bricks.how1: Bricks fall from the top: ◀ ▶ move, ⟳ turn, ⤓ drop.
bricks.how2: Stack the wall tight around the base module.
bricks.how3: Cover 85% of the green zone before time runs out.
bricks.teaches: A thick wall of Moon soil, water or ice stops space particles, so astronauts get less radiation.
bricks.start: Place bricks next to the module!
bricks.m1: A quarter of the wall is done!

dash.title: 🏃 Run to the shelter
dash.how1: Tap a tile to run there (or arrows / WASD).
dash.how2: Close the hatches 🚪 and grab the medkit 🩹 on the way.
dash.how3: Reach the green shelter before time runs out.
dash.teaches: During a solar storm, the best place is behind thick walls. The faster you hide, the less radiation you get.

hint.move: Tap where to run, or press the arrows
hint.outside: You're outside — run to the airlock!
hint.hatches: Close the hatches 🚪 — just run through them
hint.shelter: Now into the shelter — the green room!

signal.title: 📡 Tune the radio to Earth
signal.how1: Drag the «Frequency» slider so the waves are equally tight.
signal.how2: Drag «Height» so the waves are equally tall.
signal.how3: Hold the match for 2.5 seconds to decode the message.
signal.teaches: A solar flare scrambles radio. Radio operators re-tune the receiver to hear Earth again.

hint.start: Move the sliders so your wave sits on Earth's wave
hint.slip: Almost! Adjust a tiny bit more
hint.hold: Hold it! Don't move the sliders
hint.drift: The signal drifts — nudge it gently

msg.control: MISSION CONTROL: ALL GOOD, HANG ON!
msg.family: MOM: WE ARE PROUD OF YOU!

react.patrol: Oops, the panels are still dusty — less power. Replay to clean them to 80%!
react.wall: The wall wasn't finished — the shelter didn't get stronger. Try again?
react.dash: You were late to the shelter — a bit more radiation. Next time run right away!
react.signal_ok: Hooray, Earth is on the line! The crew is smiling.
react.signal_fail: The signal got lost — the crew is a bit sad. Try again!
